mode: read-only SDD test-design review; implementation tests not run

findings.finding: Tests cover retry/conflict at request_id level but do not establish HTTP Idempotency-Key scoping, completed same-key replay, concurrent one-IPC coalescing, or same-key cross-session isolation.
findings.required_action: Add deterministic Go/process FI and browser E2E cases for completed retry, concurrent retry with exactly one IPC/CreateCase, same-session key conflict before IPC, and same key in another session. Assert request-map cardinality, catalog generation/inventory, and zero unauthorized opens/effects.

findings.finding: The predicate now < expires_at_ms <= now+60s is specified, but tests only name expired grants; equality/one-millisecond boundaries and expiry between signing and IPC validation have no oracle.
findings.required_action: Add frozen-clock cases for expiry==now reject, now+1ms accept, now+60s accept, now+60s+1ms reject, and expiry during IPC wait. Assert rejection before any member/DB/key opens or business effects; map a stable browser-visible outcome in E2E.

findings.finding: Fresh run/root is stated for uncertain create, but FI-IPC-01 lacks explicit distinct epoch/root identity and new catalog inventory assertions.
findings.required_action: Assert old/new epochs and verified root identities differ; new worker never opens old root; old selector stays inaccessible; new catalog is independent and has exactly the expected inventory.

limitations: No implementation or E2E tests were run.
